`r if ("log_r" %in% names(random_par)) "### Recruitment"`

```{r, eval = "log_r" %in% names(random_par)}
plot_trend(random_par$log_r, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "Recruitment (r)")
```

`r if (any(c("log_r0", "log_r_init") %in% names(random_par))) "### Initial recruitment"`

```{r, eval = any(c("log_r0", "log_r_init") %in% names(random_par))}
initial_rec <- stack_list(random_par[intersect(c("log_r0", "log_r_init"), names(random_par))], label = NULL)
plot_par(initial_rec, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols)
```

`r if ("log_n" %in% names(random_par)) if ("log_n0" %in% names(random_par)) '### States {#random-n-states data-tab-group="N"}' else "### N"`

```{r, eval = "log_n" %in% names(random_par)}
plot_age_year(random_par$log_n,
  color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age, ylab = "Latent abundance (n)")
```

`r if ("log_n0" %in% names(random_par)) if ("log_n" %in% names(random_par)) '### Initial abundance {#random-n-initial data-tab-group="N"}' else "### N"`

```{r, eval = "log_n0" %in% names(random_par)}
plot_trend(random_par$log_n0,
  x = ~age, xlab = "Age", color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "Initial abundance")
```

`r if ("log_f" %in% names(random_par)) "### F"`

```{r, eval = "log_f" %in% names(random_par)}
f_states <- random_par$log_f
if ("age_block" %in% names(f_states)) {
  # Blocks are the estimated coordinates, rather than replicated biological ages.
  if (!"age" %in% names(f_states)) f_states$age <- NA_integer_
  f_states$age <- ifelse(is.na(f_states$age_block), as.character(f_states$age), as.character(f_states$age_block))
}
plot_age_year(f_states, x = ~year, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age, ylab = "Latent F (f)")
```

`r if ("log_m" %in% names(random_par)) "### M"`

```{r, eval = "log_m" %in% names(random_par)}
plot_trend(random_par$log_m, x = ~year, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age_block, ylab = "Latent M (m)")
```
